bone-white.$description: Bone White — Page canvas, card surfaces, border-on-hover washes — the warm off-white ground that the entire site sits on

graphite-ink.$description: Graphite Ink — Primary text, wordmark fill, body copy — near-black with a touch of warmth, softer than pure black

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Navigation text, secondary headings, muted body — the darker of the two navigation grays

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, inactive nav items, page number indicator — sits behind primary content

silver.$description: Silver — Hairline dividers, section separators, subtle card backgrounds — the structural border color

pale-mist.$description: Pale Mist — Decorative stroke work, SVG compass/field-line graphics, ultra-faint border accents

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — SVG illustration fills, maximum-contrast moments — used sparingly where the ink needs to be absolute

tt-hoves-pro-trial.$description: Sole typeface for wordmark, nav, labels, body, and metadata. The ultra-light 300 carries the enormous wordmark — a neogrotesque at whisper weight reads as confident editorial restraint rather than display shouting. 400 runs all body and nav copy; 500 is reserved for the rare emphasis moment.

neuemontreal.$description: Rare secondary face for body paragraphs in the about/descriptive blocks — a warmer geometric that softens the Hoves rigidity in long-form reading
